summary.text: David Meade is a Republican state representative from Kentucky House District 80 who has served since 2013 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
His career experience includes work with Lincoln Realty and Auction Company.

paragraphs.text: David Meade was born in Stanford, Kentucky, and attended the University of Kentucky and Lexington Community College.
His career experience includes working with Lincoln Realty and Auction Company.
He founded Mimi's House and has been a member of the National Association of Realtors, the Kentucky Auctioneers Association, and the Lincoln County Chamber of Commerce.
Meade took office in the Kentucky House on January 1, 2013.
In the 2025-2026 session he was vice chair of both the Committee on Committees and the Rules Committee.
